mapper.select:
SELECT ol.`remark` `remark`, ol.`log_time` `logTime`, cw.`wholesaler_name` `wholesalerName`, gp.`gear_position_code` `gearPositionCode`, gp.`gear_position_name` `gearPositionName`, gp.`gear_position_area` `gearPositionArea` FROM `operate_log` ol LEFT JOIN `device_position` dp ON ol.`device_id` = dp.`cold_water_device` LEFT JOIN `gear_position` gp ON dp.`gear_position_id` = gp.`gear_position_id` LEFT JOIN `cold_wholesaler` cw ON gp.`wholesaler` = cw.`wholesaler_id` where ol.`log_time` between #{param.period.begin} and #{param.period.end} and ol.`log_type` = #{param.logTypeEnum}
and ol.`device_id` = #{param.deviceId}
